backend/main.mo: Motoko backend storing expressions and responses with ID generation, status updates, moderation, and blob‑safe mutation functions.
feature_evidence.json: Report describing deployment of Version 17 with referenced files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping frontend file paths to their short descriptive summaries.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Runbook detailing prerequisites and steps for deploying Version 17 to production.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind setup defining OKLCH color variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the app root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/deployment-info.json: Metadata recording Version 17 deployment status, environment, and changelog.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes and global QueryClient provider.
frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx: Audio player component handling load, playback, progress, and error states with ExternalBlob URLs.
frontend/src/components/AudioRecorder.ts: Audio recorder capturing microphone input, producing a Blob, and supporting preview playback and reset.
frontend/src/components/ExpressTab.tsx: Handles recording, uploading, and moderating user voice expressions with empathy-type selection and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the app header with logo and title.
frontend/src/components/ListenTab.tsx: Manages assigned expressions, playback, and recording responses based on empathy type.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and tracks the backend actor instance tied to the user’s identity, invalidating queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, and identity loading via a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations for uploading, moderating, assigning, and responding to expressions.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and theme variables with custom button styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function for merging class names with Tailwind merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Archive.tsx: Placeholder archive page with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/pages/Express.tsx: Express page wrapper providing back navigation and rendering ExpressTab.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Renders the home page with three navigation buttons linking to Express, Listen, and Archive.
frontend/src/pages/Listen.tsx: Displays the Listen page with a back button and the ListenTab component.
frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.tsx: Provides the onboarding flow with language selection, an intro explanation, and a continue button to enter Home.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radii, animations, plugins, and content paths.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, features, and metadata for the Empathy Buddy app.
